= Vendors (pure ES/TS + server-side runtimes)

Third-party JavaScript and TypeScript libraries for server-side runtimes,
organized by category.

* https://nodejstoolbox.com/[Node.js Toolbox]

* *xref:languages/programming/ecmascript-languages/vendors/general-utility-and-functional-programming-libraries/index.adoc[General utility and functional programming libraries]* \
  General-purpose utility and functional programming libraries for JavaScript,
  covering common data manipulation, composition, and functional helpers.

* *xref:languages/programming/ecmascript-languages/vendors/polyfills-and-shims/index.adoc[Polyfills and shims]* \
  Polyfills and shims for ECMAScript features not natively supported in all
  environments.

* *xref:languages/programming/ecmascript-languages/vendors/asynchronous-javascript-promises/index.adoc[Asynchronous JavaScript (Promises)]* \
  Libraries for managing asynchronous control flow and promise-based patterns in
  JavaScript, including circuit breakers and effect systems.

* *xref:languages/programming/ecmascript-languages/vendors/authentication/index.adoc[Authentication]* \
  Libraries and frameworks for authenticating users in JavaScript and Node.js
  applications, including session management and OAuth strategies.

* *xref:languages/programming/ecmascript-languages/vendors/authorization/index.adoc[Authorization]* \
  Libraries for implementing authorization, permissions, and access control rules
  in JavaScript applications.

* *xref:languages/programming/ecmascript-languages/vendors/browser-automation-and-web-scraping/index.adoc[Browser automation and web scraping]* \
  Tools for automating browsers and scraping web pages, from full browser
  automation frameworks to lightweight HTML scrapers.

* *xref:languages/programming/ecmascript-languages/vendors/cli-abstractions-frameworks/index.adoc[CLI abstractions/frameworks]* \
  Libraries for building command-line interfaces in Node.js, covering argument
  parsing, interactive prompts, and terminal colour output.

* *xref:languages/programming/ecmascript-languages/vendors/color-manipulation/index.adoc[Color manipulation]* \
  Libraries for parsing, converting, and manipulating colour values in JavaScript.

* *xref:languages/programming/ecmascript-languages/vendors/parallelism-worker-threads/index.adoc[Parallelism (Worker Threads)]* \
  Libraries for running parallel work using worker threads in JavaScript.

* *xref:languages/programming/ecmascript-languages/vendors/configuration-and-env-loaders/index.adoc[Configuration and env loaders]* \
  Libraries for loading and validating application configuration from environment
  variables and config files.

* *xref:languages/programming/ecmascript-languages/vendors/cookie-abstractions/index.adoc[Cookie abstractions]* \
  Libraries for parsing, serializing, and managing HTTP cookies in JavaScript.

* *xref:languages/programming/ecmascript-languages/vendors/data-structures-entities-and-value-objects/index.adoc[Data structures, entities and value objects]* \
  Libraries for defining data structures, entities, and value objects in
  JavaScript, including immutable data, enums, and typed models.

* *xref:languages/programming/ecmascript-languages/vendors/database-and-storage-abstractions-and-orms/index.adoc[Database and storage abstractions and ORMs]* \
  Libraries for abstracting database access, including ORMs, query builders, and
  database-specific clients.

* *xref:languages/programming/ecmascript-languages/vendors/postgresql-clients/index.adoc[PostgreSQL clients]* \
  Client libraries for connecting to and querying PostgreSQL from Node.js.

* *xref:languages/programming/ecmascript-languages/vendors/object-relational-mapping-orm/index.adoc[Object-relational mapping (ORM)]* \
  Object-relational mapping (ORM) libraries for JavaScript and TypeScript.

* *xref:languages/programming/ecmascript-languages/vendors/query-builders/index.adoc[Query builders]* \
  SQL query builder libraries for JavaScript and TypeScript.

* *xref:languages/programming/ecmascript-languages/vendors/redis-clients/index.adoc[Redis clients]* \
  Client libraries for connecting to and querying Redis from Node.js.

* *xref:languages/programming/ecmascript-languages/vendors/sqlite-clients/index.adoc[SQLite clients]* \
  Client libraries for working with SQLite databases in Node.js.

* *xref:languages/programming/ecmascript-languages/vendors/db-drivers/index.adoc[DB drivers]* \
  Low-level database driver libraries for connecting to and querying specific
  database engines from Node.js.

* *xref:languages/programming/ecmascript-languages/vendors/datetime-libraries/index.adoc[Datetime libraries]* \
  Libraries for parsing, formatting, and manipulating dates and times in
  JavaScript.

* *xref:languages/programming/ecmascript-languages/vendors/dependency-injection-service-locator-ioc/index.adoc[Dependency injection + service locator (IoC)]* \
  Libraries implementing dependency injection, service locator, and inversion of
  control patterns in JavaScript.

* *xref:languages/programming/ecmascript-languages/vendors/diffing-text-libraries/index.adoc[Diffing (Text) libraries]* \
  Libraries for computing and rendering differences between text content.

* *xref:languages/programming/ecmascript-languages/vendors/dom-implementations-fakes/index.adoc[DOM implementations and fakes]* \
  Libraries that implement or fake the DOM outside a browser, for testing and
  server-side use.

* *xref:languages/programming/ecmascript-languages/vendors/email-delivery/index.adoc[Email delivery]* \
  Libraries for sending email from Node.js applications.

* *xref:languages/programming/ecmascript-languages/vendors/event-emitters-and-pubsub/index.adoc[Event emitters and pubsub]* \
  Libraries implementing event emitter and publish/subscribe patterns in
  JavaScript.

* *xref:languages/programming/ecmascript-languages/vendors/feature-detection-useragent-browser-runtime-detection/index.adoc[Feature detection and useragent/browser/runtime detection]* \
  Libraries for detecting browser/runtime features, user agents, and execution
  environments in JavaScript.

* *xref:languages/programming/ecmascript-languages/vendors/file-archiving-and-compression/index.adoc[File archiving and compression]* \
  Libraries for creating, reading, and compressing archive files such as zip, in
  JavaScript.

* *xref:languages/programming/ecmascript-languages/vendors/file-type-mimetype-detection/index.adoc[File type / mimetype detection]* \
  Libraries for detecting file types and MIME types from file content in
  JavaScript.

* *xref:languages/programming/ecmascript-languages/vendors/form-and-file-upload-processing/index.adoc[Form and file upload processing]* \
  Libraries for parsing multipart form data and handling file uploads in Node.js.

* *xref:languages/programming/ecmascript-languages/vendors/geospatial-analysis/index.adoc[Geospatial analysis]* \
  Libraries for geospatial analysis and geometric calculations in JavaScript.

* *xref:languages/programming/ecmascript-languages/vendors/graphics/index.adoc[Graphics]* \
  Libraries for rendering 2D graphics in JavaScript.

* *xref:languages/programming/ecmascript-languages/vendors/cryptography-and-hashing/index.adoc[Cryptography and hashing]* \
  Libraries for cryptographic operations and hashing in JavaScript.

* *xref:languages/programming/ecmascript-languages/vendors/hot-module-reloading/index.adoc[Hot module reloading]* \
  Libraries that add hot module reloading to Node.js applications during
  development.

* *xref:languages/programming/ecmascript-languages/vendors/http-and-websocket-clients/index.adoc[HTTP and WebSocket clients]* \
  HTTP and WebSocket client libraries for making network requests from JavaScript
  and Node.js.

* *xref:languages/programming/ecmascript-languages/vendors/http-and-websocket-servers/index.adoc[HTTP and WebSocket servers]* \
  Libraries and tools for running HTTP and WebSocket servers in Node.js, including
  lightweight static file servers.

* *xref:languages/programming/ecmascript-languages/vendors/image-generation-and-processing/index.adoc[Image generation and processing]* \
  Libraries for generating, processing, and optimizing images in Node.js.

* *xref:languages/programming/ecmascript-languages/vendors/internationalization-and-localization/index.adoc[Internationalization and localization]* \
  Libraries for internationalization and localization of JavaScript applications.

* *xref:languages/programming/ecmascript-languages/vendors/jsx-implementations/index.adoc[JSX implementations]* \
  Alternative implementations of JSX outside the React ecosystem.

* *xref:languages/programming/ecmascript-languages/vendors/jwt/index.adoc[JWT]* \
  Libraries for creating, signing, and verifying JSON Web Tokens (JWT) in
  JavaScript.

* *xref:languages/programming/ecmascript-languages/vendors/logging/index.adoc[Logging]* \
  Logging libraries and frameworks for Node.js applications.

* *xref:languages/programming/ecmascript-languages/vendors/machine-learning/index.adoc[Machine learning]* \
  Libraries for machine learning and numerical computation in JavaScript.

* *xref:languages/programming/ecmascript-languages/vendors/numbers-money-and-currency-libraries/index.adoc[Numbers, money and currency libraries]* \
  Libraries for working with numbers, money, durations, and currency in
  JavaScript.

* *xref:languages/programming/ecmascript-languages/vendors/parsers-and-compilers/index.adoc[Parsers and compilers]* \
  Parsers and compilers for various data formats and languages, including
  spreadsheets, BSON, and expression parsing.

* *xref:languages/programming/ecmascript-languages/vendors/pdf-generation/index.adoc[PDF generation]* \
  Libraries for generating and manipulating PDF documents in JavaScript.

* *xref:languages/programming/ecmascript-languages/vendors/queues/index.adoc[Queues]* \
  Lightweight in-memory queue and priority queue data structure libraries for
  JavaScript.

* *xref:languages/programming/ecmascript-languages/vendors/qr-code-generation/index.adoc[QR code generation]* \
  Libraries for generating QR codes in JavaScript.

* *xref:languages/programming/ecmascript-languages/vendors/random-uuid-passwords-hashes-and-secrets-generation/index.adoc[Random, UUID, passwords, hashes and secrets generation]* \
  Libraries for generating random values, UUIDs, passwords, hashes, and other
  secrets in JavaScript.

* *xref:languages/programming/ecmascript-languages/vendors/reactive-programming-libraries/index.adoc[Reactive programming libraries]* \
  Libraries implementing reactive programming patterns and observables in
  JavaScript.

* *xref:languages/programming/ecmascript-languages/vendors/schedulers-in-process/index.adoc[Schedulers (In-Process)]* \
  Libraries for scheduling recurring in-process tasks using cron-like syntax in
  Node.js.

* *xref:languages/programming/ecmascript-languages/vendors/screen-capture/index.adoc[Screen capture]* \
  Libraries for capturing screenshots from Node.js.

* *xref:languages/programming/ecmascript-languages/vendors/security-input-sanitization/index.adoc[Security - input sanitization, etc.]* \
  Libraries for sanitizing untrusted input and mitigating security vulnerabilities
  such as XSS in JavaScript.

* *xref:languages/programming/ecmascript-languages/vendors/server-sent-events/index.adoc[Server-sent events]* \
  Libraries for implementing server-sent events (SSE) in Node.js.

* *xref:languages/programming/ecmascript-languages/vendors/shell-scripting-shell-execution/index.adoc[Shell scripting / shell execution]* \
  Libraries for scripting shell commands and executing child processes from
  JavaScript.

* *xref:languages/programming/ecmascript-languages/vendors/ssh-abstractions-and-implementations/index.adoc[SSH abstractions and implementations]* \
  Libraries for implementing and abstracting SSH clients in Node.js.

* *xref:languages/programming/ecmascript-languages/vendors/syntax-parsing-and-highlighting/index.adoc[Syntax parsing and highlighting]* \
  Libraries for parsing and syntax-highlighting code in JavaScript.

* *xref:languages/programming/ecmascript-languages/vendors/task-job-queues/index.adoc[Task/job queues]* \
  Libraries for running background task and job queues in Node.js, typically
  backed by Redis or a database.

* *xref:languages/programming/ecmascript-languages/vendors/validation-and-assertions/index.adoc[Validation and assertions]* \
  General-purpose libraries for validating values and making assertions in
  JavaScript.

* *xref:languages/programming/ecmascript-languages/vendors/object-schema-validation/index.adoc[Object / schema validation]* \
  Libraries for validating and parsing object shapes and schemas in JavaScript.

* *xref:languages/programming/ecmascript-languages/vendors/json-schema-validation/index.adoc[JSON schema validation]* \
  Libraries for validating data against JSON Schema in JavaScript.

* *xref:languages/programming/ecmascript-languages/vendors/visual-diff-and-regression-testing/index.adoc[Visual diff and regression testing]* \
  Libraries for visual diffing and regression testing, such as comparing rendered
  output between versions.

* *xref:languages/programming/ecmascript-languages/vendors/middleware-systems/index.adoc[Middleware systems]* \
  Libraries for composing middleware pipelines in Node.js applications.
